caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest, viewed at an angle, showing the front and right side. The chest is primarily a reddish-brown color, with a flat, slightly overhanging top. The front face of the chest features three rectangular panels in the upper section, each with carved designs of stylized trees and swirling patterns set against a reddish background. Surrounding these panels and extending to the sides are elaborately carved borders with leaf and vine motifs in a darker brown shade. Below the three panels is a wide, horizontal drawer or section decorated with more swirling vine-like carvings. The chest stands on four short legs, with the carved pattern continuing around the base. The artist's name, "Francis Borelli," is written in the lower left corner of the paper outside the chest illustration. The background is plain and off-white, with a faint rectangular border around the drawing.
title: Chest
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
